review_description: Quoting was very easy, we changed a couple of times and quotes were adjustedInstallation. Punctual, polite, tidyCustomer service helped with grid connection help install app and explainedoperation

We recently worked with Skytech Energy for our solar panel installation, and we couldn’t be more impressed with the experience! From start to finish, they demonstrated exceptional professionalism, knowledge, and attention to detail.

As a technical manager in a construction company, I am accustomed to running tendering processes for design and supply packages.  I am particular around the proposed work, specification, company profile and the works processes/arrangements. I will look in detail at prices, terms and conditions.Skytech were superb throughout.In blind submissions they provided the best price.Very accommodating and clear when asked to look at the price point some differing system set ups / specifications.Great communication ahead of the work.Outstanding levels of professionalism on the day of the install, with a genuine eye for detail, setting high standards in their workmanship, working in a safe and courteous manner around my home and family.Great follow up around how to make the best use-of and the monitoring of our system.They made the arrangement for the grid connection.It is a pleasure to engage a company who take pride in their work and their service.   I'm  happy to recommend Skytech and I have done so to friend already.

The sales process was clear and pressure-free, with detailed explanations and no hidden costs. John is very knowledgeable in this industry and I felt very comfortable going ahead with him. The installation team was punctual, polite, and left everything tidy afterward. John was excellent he helped us set up the solar app afterwards and connected the wifi, he also took the time to show us how to use it.  Overall, it was a fantastic experience!

John was very patient and answered all my questions and more than happy to change the configuration of my install and requote. We had to reschedule once due to weather and once due to supply issue. John informed me of the delays and rescheduled within the week. On the day of the installation, John arrived on time and kept me informed on how the install was going. Once complete gave me demo of the app for monitoring. There was in issue with the App which John contacted the inverter company who performed a firmware fix the next day. Would definitely recommend Skytech to anyone.
